answer: Clone farms mint extra grader names so one desk can pack a panel. An applicant locks 16,400 tokens and sends a courier on a 3.7-hour voyage from dock D-14 to loft L-6 with sealed thread TR-2719 (22.5 m, 0.33 mm) bound to anemometer AZ-8, which must log a zephyr trace of 420 samples at 8-second intervals. The clerk checks leftover thread at 22.5±0.04 m and matches the trace to a 64-bin histogram; over 3 bins off, a broken seal, or more than 8 minutes late slashes 55% of the bond for 9 epochs. Thirty aliases lock 492,000 tokens and need 30 couriers; one thread cannot cover two lofts.
